test_case.purpose: After the architecture is defined, inject one approved synthetic SCC Creg error at one mapped NVLink/C2C target, prove target-specific detection/containment, and restore coherent peers, traffic, ordering and data integrity.
required_package: Authoritative SCC/Creg definition and NVIDIA architecture/tool/spec/version/checksum
Exact chip/block/register/bit, ownership, NVLink-or-C2C link and peer map
Approved synthetic stimulus and severity/latch/clear/containment semantics

Coherent workload/order/data-integrity criteria, OOB/fabric recovery and complete restoration

test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while SCC/Creg and the target are undefined. Generic link inventory/logs, wrong register/peer, missing raw status, reset/stall, poison/data mismatch, coherency failure or incomplete restoration fails or remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated non-production coherent topology with disposable verified workload and independent OOB/console.
Approved register map, synthetic method and multi-peer recovery before any write.
Abort on peer/link loss, poison/data mismatch, coherency failure, fabric stall or reset.
expected_evidence: Approved SCC/Creg definition and chip/block/register/bit/link/peer map
Exact one-shot synthetic event and synchronized register/fabric timeline

test_case.recovery: Preserve latched evidence, then clear only through the vendor procedure. Restore every register/tool/debug setting, recover affected peers/fabric through OOB if needed, and verify topology, coherent traffic, memory ordering and data hashes. Never auto-retry.
